Request: Tap in the bathroom won't quit dribbling, even cranked all the way off.
Expected_Next_Action: Contact preferred plumber and proceed within authority
Ground_Truth_Reason: Routine drip, no safety indicators, within authority.

Request: Weird rotten-egg type smell near the stove, kind of strong, noticed it maybe 15 min ago.
Expected_Next_Action: Immediate protective action and notify owner
Ground_Truth_Reason: Rotten-egg odour near a stove is a credible gas indicator; emergency mitigation plus notification. Worded without the literal phrase 'gas smell'.

Request: AC's leaking a bit and there's a wet patch spreading toward the socket on the wall.
Expected_Next_Action: Advise power-off if safe, dispatch, notify owner
Ground_Truth_Reason: Water advancing toward a socket is water-near-electrical; over-inclusive emergency. 'Socket'/'wet patch' avoid the regex vocabulary.

Request: The disposal just hums, doesn't spin at all when I flip it on.
Expected_Next_Action: Present repair decision to owner with recommendation
Ground_Truth_Reason: $230 exceeds U6's $200 limit; owner decision. Fresh version of the authority-breach pattern.

Request: Kitchen sink's draining slow again, same as a few weeks back.
Expected_Next_Action: Escalate for root-cause rather than another clear
Ground_Truth_Reason: CL-005: same failure mode (slow drain) recurring is repeat failure; override beats cheap cost.

Request: Ceiling in the hallway has a brownish mark that looks like it's getting bigger.
Expected_Next_Action: Dispatch assessment scoped to find moisture source
Ground_Truth_Reason: CL-004: enough info to determine next action (assess); root cause not required. Diagnose-first ACT, not escalate.

Request: Something's up with the front door - the deadbolt's really stiff, takes a few tries.
Clarification_Response: Asked whether the door can still be locked securely right now: no response.
Expected_Next_Action: Take minimum safe action: dispatch to confirm/secure
Ground_Truth_Reason: CL-003: safety/security question open plus silence yields a protective ACT, not AWAITING.

Request: The cabinet door under the bathroom sink is hanging off one hinge.
Clarification_Response: Asked whether it's fully detached or just loose: no response.
Expected_Next_Action: Park pending tenant information
Ground_Truth_Reason: Non-safety silence: park. Control case for HV-007 - same silence, no safety dimension.

Request: Forget what I said about the buzzing outlet, turned out the lamp plug was loose, all good now.
Expected_Next_Action: Log as resolved, no dispatch
Ground_Truth_Reason: Self-resolved, no outstanding maintenance need (CL-002).

Request: Bunch of things: porch bulb's dead, kitchen drawer's stuck, and the hot water's gone cold since this morning.
Expected_Next_Action: Decompose into three cases; action each independently in urgency order
Ground_Truth_Reason: Decision -1 (SG-002): decompose. Bulb (Routine/Electrical/ACT), drawer (Routine/General/ACT), no hot water (Priority/Plumbing/ACT-diagnose). No emergency; no item delays another.

Request: The extractor fan in unit 10 has stopped working.
Expected_Next_Action: Escalate - cannot establish authority context
Ground_Truth_Reason: Decision 0 / SG-001: unidentifiable unit; never act without authority context. Non-emergency path.

Request: Toilet's making a running/refilling noise a while after every flush.
Expected_Next_Action: Contact plumber and proceed within authority
Ground_Truth_Reason: Minor flapper-type fix within authority. U1 has no clog history, so repeat-failure must NOT fire - distinct fault.

Request: Water's really coming through the ceiling in the lounge, quite a lot of it.
Expected_Next_Action: Autonomous emergency mitigation now, then escalate permanent repair
Ground_Truth_Reason: Uncontrolled water; mitigate immediately, permanent repair (likely >$500) follows spend bands. Two-stage emergency.

Request: Washing machine's leaking and it's soaked into the floorboards, they're going kind of spongy.
Expected_Next_Action: Repair appliance and escalate the property-damage dimension
Ground_Truth_Reason: Material damage (spongy floorboards) triggers insurance/scope override; cheap repair does not neutralise damage. 'Spongy floorboards' avoids 'swelling laminate'.

Request: Can you swap the old showerhead for one of those fancy rainfall ones? Current one works fine, just want the upgrade.
Expected_Next_Action: Escalate as an owner spend/preference decision
Ground_Truth_Reason: No maintenance fault; pure upgrade request is an owner decision (upgrade override).

Request: Smoke detector in the hall keeps doing that chirp every minute or so.
Expected_Next_Action: Replace battery/unit autonomously; log priority
Ground_Truth_Reason: CL-007: chirp is a cheap autonomous fix but a life-safety device, so urgency is Priority not Routine. Chirp is not fire, so not emergency.

Request: The handrail on the outside steps wobbles when you put weight on it.
Expected_Next_Action: Protective step (advise caution/restrict use) and escalate structural assessment
Ground_Truth_Reason: CL-008: safety-critical but not an active emergency; protective ACT plus structural override escalation.

Request: Fridge has quit - everything inside is warming up, milk's already off.
Expected_Next_Action: Dispatch to diagnose; repair-vs-replace decided post-assessment
Ground_Truth_Reason: Food loss raises urgency to Priority; diagnose within authority. Diagnose-first ACT.

Request: I think water's getting in somewhere - the bill's way up but I can't find any leak.
Expected_Next_Action: Ask one focused round (damp spots, meter running, sounds), then route or escalate
Ground_Truth_Reason: Missing decision-changing information; one clarification round required before acting.

Request: There's a patch of black mould in the bathroom corner and it looks like it's creeping outward.
Expected_Next_Action: Escalate - spreading mould exceeds routine scope
Ground_Truth_Reason: Spreading mould is a moisture/health scope issue beyond routine. 'Creeping outward' avoids 'spreading'.

Request: Half the power in the flat's gone, the rest is fine, no storm or anything.
Expected_Next_Action: Dispatch electrician to assess
Ground_Truth_Reason: Partial outage is likely a tripped circuit or fault; assess. Not an emergency absent burning/sparking - must NOT force-escalate.

Request: The only loo in the place won't flush at all now.
Expected_Next_Action: Dispatch plumber within authority
Ground_Truth_Reason: Sole bathroom raises urgency to Priority; within authority. Urgency from impact, not hazard.

Request: AC's just blowing warm, not cooling since last night.
Clarification_Response: Vendor: compressor failed, ~$1,500 for full replacement.
Expected_Next_Action: Escalate repair-vs-replace decision with options
Ground_Truth_Reason: Exceeds $500 and triggers replacement override; owner decides. Scope explosion after dispatch.

Request: Bedroom window won't latch shut - it's the ground-floor one right on the street side.
Expected_Next_Action: Protective step to secure; arrange repair
Ground_Truth_Reason: Accessible ground-floor window is a security exposure; accessibility stated up front so no ASK needed - protective ACT.
